Q0428

“It is not that we have a short time to live, but…” — Seneca (On the Shortness of Life 1.3)

Verified English quotation. Primary source: On the Shortness of Life 1.3. Theme: time.

Quotes / Seneca / Q0428

English

It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a great deal of it.
Thinker Seneca
School Stoicism
Source On the Shortness of Life 1.3
Theme Time
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with On the Shortness of Life 1.3, within the Stoicism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of time, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Seneca's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
